text:
nora: Flagging a new customer ask from MedPrompt. They want an "Optimize Autosuggest" pilot: automatic batching + cache recommendations surfaced in Console and lightweight eval-trigger alerts. Pilot target: clinical note extraction workload in 6 weeks.

diego: 6 weeks is tight. Can we reduce scope to ship a minimum lovable product (MLP)? my suggestion: (A) heuristic-driven batching (no ML control loop), (B) basic prefix/KV cache toggles + measured token savings, (C) read-only eval alerts (console notifications only). Defer quantization guidance to phase 2.

rachel: Agree with the MLP. Need to confirm SLAs: what latency and quality constraints does MedPrompt need?

nora: MedPrompt's ask: p95 < 320ms for short requests, and they'll accept <= 3.5% drop on our summary F1 before a human review. They want alerts if quality crosses threshold for 2 consecutive windows of 500 requests.

tariq: Ops constraints: pilot will run on Dedicated with mixed A100 + T4s. We need safe batch ceilings per GPU class. Also must ensure batching doesn't push p99 > 700ms. We'll surface per-GPU batch histograms.

diego: Implementation sketch: bucket by request token-length, choose static max batch for each bucket, enforce runtime latency cap by draining batches early if tail latency approaches budget. Fallback to sync path on timeouts. Example config: ```json { "buckets": [50, 200, 800], "max_batch": [12, 6, 3], "latency_cap_ms": 320 } ```

rachel: For caching, expose two knobs: prefix_ttl_seconds and kv_cache_mode (off/light/aggressive). Default mid: 30s TTL, kv_cache_mode=light. We'll need telemetry for hit rate and token savings.

tariq: infra-bot:precheck -> we can add these metrics to the ingestion pipeline but need a small schema tag `optimize_v1` for batch/cache signals. I'll open INF-5201. ETA 4d.

infra-bot: ticket created: INF-5201 to add optimize_v1 tag.

diego: Eval alerts: hook into eval infra. Signals: (1) sentinel probe failure rate, (2) embedding-distribution shift, (3) ROUGE/F1 regression on sample set. Combine into a weighted score; threshold breach for 2 windows => alert. Window size = 500 requests.

nora: Important: need MedPrompt to provide either a 1k labeled eval set or allow us to run sentinel queries against their production canonicalization. If they can't, we run expanded sentinel suite on synthetic queries but risk missing edge cases.

rachel: Acceptance criteria for pilot: 1) batch + cache controls live and visible in Console, 2) per-route latency dashboards showing p95 under target, 3) eval alert visible in Console with link to eval job detail, 4) customer sign-off on signal definitions and thresholds.

diego: Timeline breakdown: week 1 infra tagging + eval hook, week 2 implement heuristic batching + cache toggles, week 3 add telemetry + Console surface, week 4 run internal smoke + staging, week 5 pilot with customer traffic, week 6 iterate and produce handoff docs. That's 6 weeks but tight—assumes no major infra blockers.

tariq: Risk: noisy alerts from small sample sizes. Mitigation: require confirmation of alert via human review before any mitigation action. We'll also add a cool-down period for repeated alerts.

nora: Negotiation note for MedPrompt: We'll deliver MLP with read-only alerts and recommendations. Auto-apply/auto-rollback, quantization recs, and per-model ML-based tuning will be in phase 2 (4-6 weeks after pilot).

rachel: Can product draft the exact recommendation UI copy? customers ask for short explanation tooltips like "Why this batch size?" and a quick estimate of token savings.

diego: I'll draft the UI copy and a small CSV export of recommended config. Also will provide a JSON sample config to import.

infra-bot: runbook stub created: RUN-2115. Steps: acknowledge alert, run eval job, compare to baseline, escalate to model-owner, toggle batching to conservative mode if emergency.

nora: Okay. Action items: (1) nora -> ask MedPrompt for traffic_profile.csv and eval_labels.csv; (2) diego -> PR for heuristic batching by next Tue; (3) tariq -> INF-5201 ETA and reserve Dedicated slice; (4) rachel -> Console mockups + tooltip copy.

nora: I'll also ask MedPrompt to sign the pilot acceptance doc with explicit metrics mapping (which F1 variant counts). Will cc legal if needed.

diego: Quick implementation note: make the heuristic param names stable so we can later add ML controller. e.g., `optimize.batching.buckets` and `optimize.cache.prefix_ttl`.

rachel: We'll demo a simple breakdown: before vs after token counts, p95 latency change, and a sample eval alert explanation. Keep it short and actionable.

tariq: Reservation done: dedicated slice reserved (A100-1 + T4-2) for weeks 5-6.

nora: Great. If MedPrompt can only deliver partial eval data, we will run additional sentinel probes. I'll schedule the kickoff call and share scope doc. Thanks team. :party-parrot:
